caseNameFull: Heckler, Secretary of Health and Human Services v. American Hospital Assn.

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. [Certiorari granted, 472 U. S. 1016.] Motion of American Coalition of Citizens with Disabilities et al. for leave to participate in oral argument as amici curiae, for divided argument, and for additional time for oral argument denied. Motion of respondents for divided argument granted.
